title: Swap the two halves of the carried inner-proof accumulator; require refusal at the carried pairing
verdictRule: Reject means verifies=false with exit 0 AND pairing_verifies=false (mutation.requireReport). A decoder refusal or a refusal only by the outer PLONK check does not satisfy this case.

target.artifact: Sherlock A102->A80 k20 parent proof (6,432 bytes), instance lanes 16..27 = carried accumulator (lhs 16..21, rhs 22..27)

mutation.description: swap instance lanes 16..21 with 22..27 (both flag lanes stay 1, so both points still decode); everything else unchanged

seed.note: A8 cold review (qa/sherlock/traces/review-a8-t3.txt, finding 2): every retained cryptographic rejection had pairing_verifies=true, so replacing the carried check with `true` left A7 green.

rationale: The inner (child) proofs reach the parent only as a deferred accumulator whose pairing is checked outside the circuit. A verifier that skips or hard-codes that pairing still refuses every outer-proof mutation, so the suite must contain a case whose oracle is the carried pairing itself. This case kills the 'carried := true' mutant: with the check removed, pairing_verifies is true and the case fails. Limitation: the swap also changes the outer public inputs, so stdlib_verifies is false too; it isolates the pairing result, not a valid-outer/invalid-inner proof.

followUp.fixture: invalid-carried-parent/{proof.bin,instance.json} under DW_PARENT_FIXTURE_DIR, proven with the A3 parent key (vk.bin) over a child proof whose final opening is tampered, with the off-circuit child/accumulator guards of prove_link_parent (crates/mori-recursion/src/parent.rs, verify_sherlock_child_offcircuit and the folded-accumulator pairing) bypassed only in a test-only producer
followUp.note: Not gating until the fixture exists; when it does, the evaluator adds it as a case with requireReport {stdlib_verifies:true, pairing_verifies:false}.
